lessons.trigger_condition: save_confirmation checked a market key's existence without validating that its game, card number and edition belonged to the confirmed card; malicious or mistaken input could pollute device-local learning and price linking.
lessons.prevention_rule: When the confirmation supplies a market key, reject a mismatched game and mismatched known card number or known edition before acquiring the learning lock or writing any training record; preserve explicitly user-confirmed no-key workflow.
validation_required: Reject Pokémon confirmation mapped to One Piece/Naruto market key before local write
Reject mismatching collector number for an existing known market row before local write
Reject mismatching KR/JP/US edition when both are known
Allow valid same-game same-number same-region confirmation and no-key records
Keep V620 and V567 reviewed OCR provenance pinned independently from exact V568 successor
Full OCR, current-head integrity, tablet GPT sync, exhaustive SELFREFINE and CodeQL required
lessons.safety_boundary: No new pricing source, no unsupported TCG grading, no automatic learning without user confirmation; no change to old verified model weights or Lenovo user data.
